name: Environmental Enhancement Fund
summary: Regional council grants of up to NZD 25,000 a year for community groups in the Bay of Plenty to plant natives, trap pests and build small restoration infrastructure.
reporting: regular monitoring and reporting to let us know how it’s going

administered_by.quote: Your project is not receiving funding from any other Bay of Plenty Regional Council programmes for the same work

applicant_types.quote: You are a community based group (not a private individual, commercial entity*, Government agency or district/city council).

geography.quote: Your project group and location are in the Bay of Plenty.

access.quote: Download and complete the Application Form and email this to eefund@boprc.govt.nz.

amount.quote: You can apply for up to $25,000 per financial year (July 1 to June 30) for your project.

reporting.quote: You’re committed to the long‑term success of the project, including maintaining the project, and will do regular monitoring and reporting to let us know how it’s going.
